name: neruva-record
summary: Auto-record AI agent activity into Neruva. v0.11 ships AUTO-PILOT (3 pattern-C layers): NERUVA_AUTO_EXTRACT (KG auto-builds from records_ingest), NERUVA_AUTO_ROUTE (18-pattern intent classifier routes user prompts to the right cognitive tool), NERUVA_AUTO_REFLECT (self-curates decisions/facts/mistakes from recent turns). Plus 8-language code-graph (Python/JS/TS/Go/Rust/Java/Ruby/C++), per-turn semantic recall, 14-pattern secrets redaction.
